# Rule: nested rectangles of 2/5 from just inside outer 5-frame. Verify f reproduces demos.
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find bounding box of the 5 frame: minimal rect whose border is all 5 and interior contains 0s
    bb=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]
    rs=[i for i,j in bb]; cs=[j for i,j in bb]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    o=g[:]
    for k in range(max(r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1)//2) if False else 0:
        pass
    # draw rings from inside moving out: rings at offset d from inner edge
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    r=r0+1; c=c0+1
    alt=2
    # ring boundary cells: rows r..c1-1? careful: ring spans r0+k? Outer frame is the given 5-border at r0,r1,c0,c1.
    # ring k: rows r0+k ... r1-k, cols c0+k ... c1-k, color 2 if k even else 5. But outer border stays 5.
    # interior shrink: start ring k=1: rows r0+1..r1-1, cols c0+1..c1-1
    k=1
    while True:
        top,bot=r0+k,r1-k; left,right=c0+k,c1-k
        if top>bot or left>right: break
        if top+1>bot or left+1>right:  # leftover too thin: skip this ring and stop? 
            # per demos: demo2 leftover 2x2 center stayed 0. Stop when can't draw ring of thickness1
            if bot-top==1 and right-left==1: break  # would draw 1x1 center: don't? demo2 kept center 0. yes
        for i in range(top,bot+1):
            for j in range(left,right+1):
                out[i][j]= 2 if k%2==0 else 5
        k+=1
    return out

def solve(I, skip3=False):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bb=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==5]
    r0=min(i for i,j in bb); r1=max(i for i,j in bb)
    c0=min(j for i,j in bb); c1=max(j for i,j in bb)
    n=r1-r0-1
    out=[[I[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    k=1
    while True:
        size=n-2*(k-1)
        if size<=1: break
        col=2 if k%2==1 else 5
        inner_rows,inner_cols=r0+k,c0+k
        if size==2:
            for i in range(inner_rows,inner_rows+size):
                for j in range(inner_cols,inner_cols+size): out[i][j]=col

                if i in (inner_rows,inner_rows+size-1) or j in (inner_cols,inner_cols+size-1):
                    out[i][j]=col
        k+=1
    return out

def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    def rec(r,c,H,W,col):
        if H<3 or W<3: return
        for j in range(c,c+W): g[r][j]=col; g[r+H-1][j]=col
        for i in range(r,r+H): g[i][c]=col; g[i][c+W-1]=col
        ih,iw=H-2,W-2
        if ih>=3 and iw>=3:
            rec(r+1,c+1,ih,iw,2 if col==5 else 5)
        elif ih==2 and iw==2:
            for i in range(r+1,r+3):
                for j in range(c+1,c+3): g[i][j]=2 if col==5 else 5
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    nz=[(i,j) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]!=0]
    rs=[i for i,_ in nz]; cs=[j for _,j in nz]
    r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs); r1=max(rs); c1=max(cs)
    H=r1-r0+1; W=c1-c0+1
    rec(r0,c0,H,W,5)
    return g
for n,(k,i_,o) in enumerate(pairs,1):
